title: [decision] the retire-vs-remove discriminator is stated at four sites in published JSDoc — convert them to cite one block, leave them, or make the pin enforce their agreement
body:
Dedup keywords: `retire-vs-remove discriminator` · `ChatbotSchema` · published JSDoc · cite-vs-restate · `tombstone-discriminator-agreement-9684` · ablation C

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 3) out of the isolated at-tier contract review of PR objectui#9926 (card objectui#9684). ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, ⛔ no `domain:*` applied — routing is the triage seat's. The measurements below are **the review's**, cited rather than re-derived: record comment `5734125317` on PR objectui#9926, head `ead58317a404d4871b94d052ea23e982e0c76938`.

## The question

`packages/types/src/mobile.ts` now **cites** one statement of the retire-vs-remove discriminator instead of restating it. `packages/types/src/complex.ts` still **states** it at four sites. Those four are JSDoc on exported members, so they reach the published `.d.ts`; `mobile.ts`'s were line comments and did not.

⇒ **Convert the four, leave them, or make the pin enforce their agreement?**

## What is measured, and by whom

- The population on the PR's base is **eight**, not the six the card claimed, and the card's own probe returns **seven** — its table omits one note that answers the probe through `Prong 1:` / `Prong 2:` lines. The card's "zero hits outside them" control is also not a reading: the probe fires in nine further files tree-wide.
- The `.d.ts` asymmetry is **measured, not argued**: across full rebuilds with fresh output every run, a marker in a `mobile.ts` line comment reaches `dist` **0** times; the same marker in the `ChatbotSchema` JSDoc reaches `dist/complex.d.ts` **once** and moves the declaration-set hash. A line comment attached directly to an exported declaration also reaches `dist` 0 times ⇒ the asymmetry is JSDoc-vs-line-comment, ⛔ not module-scope-vs-attached.
- ⭐ **Ablation C is the fact that changes the answer.** The new pin shipped by PR objectui#9926 was ablated five ways. Four were caught. The fifth — *a third prong added to the `ChatbotSchema` statement and nowhere else* — **passes 12/12**. The pin guards one clause (the objectui#7678 surviving-carrier precondition), ⛔ not agreement between the four survivors. So the cost of leaving the four is a **four-site hand edit whose miss is silent again**, which is the exact failure objectui#9684 exists to name.

⚠️ The delivering dev recommended leaving them, and reached that recommendation **without ablation C**, whose measurement came later. Its argument is not thereby wrong, but it is re-argued below rather than carried forward.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets

- ① **项目长远合理性** — A 把「一条规则一处陈述」这条不变量真正建立起来,缩小特例;B 保留四处并生,每次修订都是 N 处手编,N 随退役数增长;C 不动已发布面,但用钉把并生变成**可失败**的,特例仍在、增生被封顶。
- ② **实际业务拉动** — ⛔ 零个具名 `.d.ts` 消费者为「跳一次」付过代价(⛔ 未实测,见置信缺口);而**被静默漏改的代价这个项目已经付过两次**(objectui#7678 的修订漏一处,本卡自己的表又漏两处)。拉动在防漏改一侧,不在阅读体验一侧。
- ③ **防 AI 犯错** — 判据是「响亮拒绝优于静默容忍」。B 今天是静默的(ablation C 12/12 通过)。A 与 C 都能变响亮:A 靠结构(只剩一处可改),C 靠钉(改了任一处、四处不一致就红)。⛔ A 与 C 在这条轴上并列,⛔ 不是 A 独胜。
- ④ **创业阶段不扩散** — A 动**已发布 `.d.ts` 字节**,是对外可见面的一次扩张性改动,需要真 changeset;C 只动测试,已发布面零字节。这条轴明确偏 C,其次 B,⛔ 最后 A。

Prior rulings read: single source of truth,duplicated prose,restate,cite instead → 4 hits; ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0130 D8 — ⛔ **neither rules on this question**: ADR-0061 D2 is the single source of truth for *searchable fields*, ADR-0130 D8 is *no owner/publisher field on the release manifest*. Both are keyword coincidences, read at 2026-09-18T18:05:08Z. A broader term set (`tombstone,discriminator,docblock,jsdoc,canonical,citation`) named ten ADR decisions at 2026-09-18T18:04:58Z; none is about duplicated normative prose in published JSDoc. ⇒ no accepted decision answers this, so it is a decision and ⛔ not execution.

## Options

- **A — convert all four `complex.ts` statements to cite one block, and name that block canonical.** The next amendment is a one-site edit. Costs: the published `.d.ts` bytes move (a real changeset), and every declarations reader of `KanbanColumn.color`, `displayMode` or `triggerIcon` must jump to `ChatbotSchema` to learn why their key is a tombstone.
- **B — leave the four inline, do not name the block canonical** (what PR objectui#9926 ships today). Four sites to amend instead of eight. ⛔ Per ablation C, a missed site is still **silent**.
- **C — leave the four inline, and widen the pin to enforce agreement between them.** ⛔ Zero published bytes move. A future amendment at one site and not the others goes **red** instead of quiet. Does ⛔ not reduce the edit to one site; it removes the silence, which is what actually cost this project twice.

**Recommendation: C**, with A as the fallback if you want the class closed structurally rather than guarded.

Self-check — 只看① 选 **A**(它是唯一真正消除并生的);②③④ 是否翻转:② 翻转(真实代价在漏改一侧,而漏改 C 也能拦住,⛔ 没有具名读者为跳转付过代价)· ③ 不翻转但也不独归 A(A 与 C 并列响亮)· ④ 翻转(A 动已发布面,C 零字节,创业阶段从紧)⇒ **三轴中两轴翻转、一轴并列,结论从 A 移到 C**。⛔ B 在任何一轴上都不领先,它只是今天的现状。

Confidence gaps, stated because they are invisible otherwise: ① ⛔ **not measured** — whether any named external consumer reads these declarations at all, so ②'s "zero pull on the reading side" is an absence of evidence and ⛔ not evidence of absence; ② ⛔ **not measured** — the cost of widening the pin (option C), which nobody has implemented or ablated; ③ the ablation numbers, the `.d.ts` marker legs and the population counts are the **review's** readings, re-derived by it with its own instrument and its own controls, and this seat has ⛔ not independently re-run them.

Refs: objectui#9684 (the card) · PR objectui#9926 (the delivery) · review record `5734125317` · objectui#7678 (the amendment that was missed once) · objectui#5941, objectui#7526 (the precedent changesets the rule is quoted from).
